bio.highlight: I started coding because I liked making things.
bio.text1: Studied CS in college and got into web dev along the way. Worked on both frontend and backend, but frontend clicked the most — seeing results on screen right away just fits me.
bio.text2: Built this portfolio from scratch, picking up GSAP and Framer Motion in the process. I learn best by jumping in and figuring things out as I go.

lighthouse.title: Lighthouse Performance Optimization
lighthouse.desc: Performance optimization based on two rounds of Lighthouse analysis. Removed 4 unused fonts (12 files), implemented interaction-based lazy loading for reCAPTCHA, applied font-display:swap to achieve mobile Performance 60→98, and reduced page size by 70%.

worksGallery.title: Works Horizontal Gallery
worksGallery.desc: Horizontal scroll gallery based on GSAP requestAnimationFrame. Placed intro section as an in-flow item, implemented bidirectional infinite scroll with oneSetWidth wrapping. Prevents layout shift during language switching with min-height.
